resolution: Part of the walk-through-walls investigation resolved by 8f5b03607 (guard the slope side-push skip in framework/game/physics.zig). Earlier steps in the same hunt ruled out the buffer/cap-truncation theory (Embodied.tsx prop-vs-wall ordering, left as a correct-on-its-own improvement) and the player-capsule-radius theory (radius is a normal 0.34m). The actual cause was the unguarded slope_walkable skip dropping tall finite-floor walls' side-push on painted heightfield terrain. Verified by the user. NOTE: barrels not colliding in the COMPILED build remains separately open (a dynamic-prop bake gap).
